sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – 1.4404 bar: conditional packages for pricing committee approval
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and for your proposal to agree a price basis with an AS-14404 adjustment clause. We recognise that alloy costs have been volatile, and we are prepared to share part of that risk within a clearly defined clause.

Your key account manager explained at our annual review that price changes above 2 % require the approval of your pricing committee (doc:20260812-70740-M3). Please put the complete packages below to the pricing committee or the authorised decision-maker now, so that we can settle this without further loops. Your sales director also told us that Werdenfels is focusing on customers with volume (doc:20260916-70740-M5). Our packages therefore cover our full two-year requirement of 23,700 kg per year, rather than the 12 months in your offer.

For market context, we hold a current quote for the same part at EUR 5.45/kg, DAP, 30 days net (quote:7300008). Its material coverage runs only until March 2027.

We propose the following packages. All are 24 months, DAP, 14-day delivery, effective 2027-01-01, with no tooling:

A: EUR 5.18/kg, payment 90 days net, fixed price (no index clause).
B: EUR 5.13/kg, payment 90 days net, index clause AS-14404, material share 45 %, deadband 5 %, base month 2026-08.
C: EUR 4.94/kg, payment 14 days net, index clause AS-14404, material share 45 %, deadband 0 %, base month 2026-08.

For us the packages are approximately equivalent after rounding, and you may choose the one that suits you best. Each price, payment term and clause is one indivisible conditional package. Faster payment or a narrower deadband applies only with that package price.

Which complete package can the authorized pricing decision-maker approve, or which priced term prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Part 370010 – 36-month conditional packages for pricing committee approval
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving to a two-year term with an AS-14404 clause.

You asked about the market quote we referred to. It is quote:7300008, dated 2026-09-10, for this same part (part:370010): EUR 5.45/kg, DAP, 30 days net, 10-day delivery. Its material is covered only until March 2027, so we treat it as a limited-period market reference rather than a full two-year alternative. It is not a Werdenfels quote.

You built on our third package. That package combined 14-day payment and a 0 % deadband with a price of EUR 4.94 only. The 14-day / 0 % structure at EUR 5.60 is therefore not agreed, and we are not offering it in this round.

Instead, we add a commitment your sales director has told us matters to Werdenfels: volume (doc:20260916-70740-M5). We are prepared to commit for 36 months at 23,700 kg per year. The third year is offered only within the complete packages below, not on its own. All packages are DAP, 14-day delivery, effective 2027-01-01, with no tooling. Both include the AS-14404 clause with material share 45 %, deadband 5 % and base month 2026-08.

A: EUR 5.25/kg, payment 90 days net, 36 months.
B: EUR 5.18/kg, payment 30 days net, 36 months.

For us the two packages are approximately equivalent after rounding. Each price, payment term and clause is one indivisible conditional package. The 36-month term and the 30-day payment apply only with that package price.

Your key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of your pricing committee (doc:20260812-70740-M3). Please put these complete packages to the pricing committee or the authorised decision-maker now. In return for the third year, please send an authorised, improved complete offer.

Which complete package can the authorised pricing decision-maker approve, or which priced term prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
